description: Plan de Protección Civil Municipal ante Tsunami is a dataset listed in Chilean national open data portal (datos.gob.cl), an open data portal, published or maintained by Servicio Nacional de Prevención y Respuesta ante Desastres. Planos parala evacuación de la población frente a riesgo de tsunami, graficando el Área a Evacuar, vías de Evacuación, Línea de Seguridad y los Puntos de Encuentro en áreas seguras. Coverage: Chile. The portal files it under the publisher Servicio Nacional de Prevención y Respuesta ante Desastres. Its tags are Evacuación, Municipios, Protección Civil, onemi. It offers 2 resource(s) in ZIP. The portal shows 2015-10-30 as the last update. It is reached through the links recorded on this page, with the catalogue entry as the discovery route. Access is free of charge and open. The licence is Creative Commons Non-Commercial (Any). Caveats: this record was written from the catalogue listing only, so the linked page was not opened, its contents and current availability were not checked, and the description may lag the source. It can support natural hazard exposure and risk studies. Related record: the catalogue-level record data-am-cl-portal.
